fusions.name: Milling Crowd
fusions.desc: Shoves through the crowd round you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally nearby (max 32%).

fusions.name: Bell Rope
fusions.desc: Cracks a thread-wound rope at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 28 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach. Allies strike 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Blanket Round
fusions.desc: Draws a blanket round the herd, restoring 12 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Woolly Comfort
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 50%, healing you receive is 40% stronger for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
